{{Quote|We seek justice, not vengeance. And that is why I know we shall triumph.|Hologram of Micae|<ref name="Death" />}}
'''Micae''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] from [[Garth (city)|Garth]], a [[City/Legends|city]] in the [[North Country]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. Son of [[Terandi]], Micae was a kid when the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] invaded the city of Garth and forced many of its inhabitants into concentration camps. [[Micae's mother|His mother]] [[Death/Legends|died]] during that invasion. Micae and his three eldest sons fought in a later battle, where they were killed, but his youngest son, five-year-old [[Nield]], remained behind. Micae's wife [[Leidra]] died one month later in another battle. A [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Micae was placed in a [[Hall of Evidence]] over [[Lake Weir]] in the [[Outer Circle]] region around the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Zehava]].
